rollbackPolicy.primary: Set environment flag to previous value or redeploy previous package
steps: Redeploy previous server executable/build from CHANGELOG entry
Restart service and confirm /api/staging/implementation-version returns previous manifest

implementations.summary: Keep claimed patients visible and refresh only their phone availability without reloading the roster.
implementations.effect: The phone icon is green when callable, red during an active call, and amber during the configured cooldown; red and amber states identify the claiming agent and amber shows the remaining seconds.
implementations.risk: MicroSIP cannot report native call state, so its claim appears as cooldown for the configured inactive timeout.

rollback.action: Remove the lock-status endpoint and status poll, then restore filtering of locks held by other agents from the queue response.

implementations.summary: Acquire a patient claim only when an agent clicks the phone icon instead of claiming every patient displayed on a queue page; heartbeat requests may extend but never create claims.
implementations.effect: Multiple agents can browse the same queue concurrently while duplicate calls to the same patient remain blocked during an active RX Softphone workflow. Backoffice controls the inactive claim timeout from 5 to 300 seconds, defaulting to 15.
implementations.risk: MicroSIP cannot report call state, so its claim uses the configured inactive timeout even if the external MicroSIP call continues longer.

rollback.action: Restore queue-page claim acquisition and the locksAcquired roster response behavior.

implementations.summary: Present Patient Activity and Call Attempts as linked views under the same Call Center filters instead of vertically stacking both reports.
implementations.effect: Administrators keep the selected patient and date context while switching between patient-level activity and detailed automatic call telemetry; each view retains its own metrics, pagination, and exports.
implementations.risk: The detailed Call Attempts view is populated only by RX Softphone telemetry recorded after this feature is deployed; historical manual or MicroSIP calls cannot be reconstructed.

rollback.action: Restore the vertically stacked report markup and remove the cross-view navigation handlers.

implementations.summary: Clear only staging Call Center history and create one linked, clearly identified answered RX Softphone simulation.
implementations.effect: Provides a deterministic report fixture while preserving patients, users, phone assignments, RX records, and all non-Call-Center history.
implementations.risk: Call Center attempts, locks, notes, service-date history, and audits in the explicitly confirmed staging database are deleted when the script runs.

rollback.action: Restore the deleted staging Call Center history from a database backup; the reset is intentionally not available for production-named or shared databases.

implementations.summary: Persist every RX Softphone dial attempt before local dialing and automatically record Called only after an answered state.
implementations.effect: Administrators can report call timing, duration, outcome, SIP result, patient snapshot, agent, extension, and dialed number while unanswered attempts remain separate from Called activity.
implementations.risk: RX Softphone versions before 0.3.0 do not provide the complete native timestamp/outcome telemetry.

rollback.action: Redeploy version 3.1.0 and leave the additive CallCenterCallAttempts table in place for forward recovery.

implementations.summary: Require a timing-safe administrator PIN for phone-account saves when SOFTPHONE_ACCOUNT_ADMIN_PIN is configured.
implementations.effect: Prevents accidental SIP assignment edits while keeping automatic per-user registration and local Disconnect behavior unchanged.
implementations.risk: Users cannot save account changes if the configured administrator PIN is unavailable.

rollback.action: Remove SOFTPHONE_ACCOUNT_ADMIN_PIN from the staging environment and restart, or redeploy the previous version.

implementations.summary: Run browser fixtures on a dedicated *_ui_smoke database and random loopback port.
implementations.effect: Automated test patients and related records no longer appear or disappear in shared staging during manual testing.
implementations.risk: The staging PostgreSQL user needs permission to create the isolated smoke database on first run.

rollback.action: Use the core smoke script only with STAGING_UI_SMOKE_ALLOW_SHARED_DB=true after explicitly accepting shared-data mutation risk.

implementations.summary: Gate database bootstrap and startup migrations on staging only when explicit flags are enabled.
implementations.effect: Prevents destructive auto-bootstrapping and migration churn on staged environments that are intentionally read-only or restored copies.
implementations.risk: A staging instance with empty DB and both flags false will start without schema tables and can fail auth/API features expecting data structures.

rollback.action: Set STAGING_AUTO_MIGRATE=true or STAGING_ALLOW_DB_BOOTSTRAP=true for temporary bootstrap, or revert this commit.
rollback.restoreExample: Revert file changes and restart to restore historical startup behavior.

implementations.summary: Fail-closed on token DB-check exceptions in staging (returns 503 instead of allowing token if DB is unavailable).
implementations.effect: Prevents authenticated bypass when session validation storage is unavailable, improving integrity during staging incidents.
implementations.risk: Staging users may be unable to access the app if DB is temporarily unreachable during maintenance windows.

rollback.action: Remove the staging-only DB exception branch and restore existing error tolerance behavior.
rollback.restoreExample: Set `isStagingEnvironment` path to false or move logic to non-staging environments only.

implementations.summary: Add staging implementation manifest endpoint and stage-only destructive action confirmation middleware.
implementations.effect: All destructive routes now require an explicit confirmation token when STAGING_DESTRUCTIVE_GUARD=true.
implementations.risk: Automation jobs and operators without confirmation token can no longer call destructive routes in staging.

rollback.action: Unset STAGING_DESTRUCTIVE_GUARD and remove middleware usage in staging routes, or revert router changes.
rollback.restoreExample: Re-run previous commit and restart service after clearing staging guard env vars.

implementations.summary: Replace shell-style command execution for git log with spawn-based process invocation.
implementations.effect: Eliminates command-string interpolation risk and gives bounded timeout/event handling.
implementations.risk: Changed error reporting shape to include close-code based responses in non-standard conditions.

rollback.action: Revert git log route to previous safe-checked execSync block if needed, then restart service.

implementations.summary: Require staging destructive confirmation token for all generated CRUD delete actions when STAGING_DESTRUCTIVE_GUARD=true.
implementations.effect: Prevents accidental deletes via admin endpoints like patients/rx records/medication catalog in staging without explicit confirmation context.
implementations.risk: Some legacy staging scripts that call delete endpoints without header/token will now receive HTTP 428.

rollback.action: Remove requireStagingDestructiveConfirmation from generateCRUDRoutes delete chain and restart.

implementations.summary: Sanitize restore SQL identifiers/strings when terminating connections and recreating database.
implementations.effect: Improves resilience and prevents malformed restore target names from breaking SQL execution.
implementations.risk: No functional behavior change except improved compatibility on odd database names.

rollback.action: Revert restore path SQL builder and use previous concatenated literals.
rollback.restoreExample: Restore file and restart background services.

implementations.summary: Generate PowerShell backup script from JSON payload instead of inline path interpolation.
implementations.effect: Prevents shell injection through file paths and normalizes exclusion filtering for zip contents.
implementations.risk: Temporary restore path mismatch in very old PowerShell hosts if JSON argument handling differs.

rollback.action: Reapply previous inline string interpolation backup script block.
rollback.restoreExample: Redeploy previous version and remove _sitebackup*.ps1 files if present.

implementations.summary: Allowlist workflow action body keys (name/sequenceNumber/description/isActive) and force create to isActive=true.
implementations.effect: Blocks over-posting and accidental deactivation/unknown field writes through API clients.
implementations.risk: Clients expecting undocumented mutable fields on workflow actions will stop persisting those fields.

rollback.action: Drop `sanitizeWorkflowPayload` and direct request body usage, then restart API workers.

implementations.summary: Create quote-safe database identifier when auto-creating staging DB in ensureDatabase().
implementations.effect: Prevents breakage from unusual DB_NAME characters and keeps startup behavior deterministic.
implementations.risk: No measurable regression risk when DB_NAME follows expected naming.

rollback.action: Revert to interpolated CREATE DATABASE literal.

implementations.summary: Preserve launcher-prepared staging variables and assert the expected port, database, and writable root before startup.
implementations.effect: Prevents a staging launcher from being silently redirected to root .env port/database values.
implementations.risk: A mismatched or incomplete staging profile now fails fast instead of starting with mixed settings.

rollback.action: Remove RX_ENV_PROFILE assertions and restore historical dotenv override behavior.

implementations.summary: Read public location and anchor URLs through rewrite-resistant dynamic properties.
implementations.effect: Keeps API and navigation requests under the public FortiGate proxy prefix and prevents internal-host URL leakage or CSRF classification bypass.
implementations.risk: A different proxy that does not expose normal Location/HTMLAnchorElement properties would fall back to existing route defaults.

rollback.action: Revert rxElementHref/native-location helpers and the Call Center/Dashboard consumers.

implementations.summary: Transport CSRF in headers and request bodies, retry one explicit stale-token rejection after cookie synchronization, and disable proxy caching of static security code.
implementations.effect: Cookie-authenticated mutations remain fail-closed while long-lived proxy tabs recover from a server-refreshed CSRF token.
implementations.risk: An explicit CSRF rejection can result in one additional rejected-safe retry sequence; successful writes are never automatically repeated.

rollback.action: Remove rxSyncCsrfTokenFromCookie/retry logic and restore the previous static cache policy.

implementations.summary: Create and clean up a short-lived import-capable user for the import smoke test.
implementations.effect: Removes dependency on stale stored/default staging credentials and keeps operator credentials out of committed files.
implementations.risk: A smoke run interrupted before finally cleanup may require removal of a staging_import_smoke_* fixture.

rollback.action: Restore configured STAGING_SMOKE_USER/STAGING_SMOKE_PASS authentication.

possibleImpacts.scenario: Automated script calls destructive staging endpoint without token
possibleImpacts.result: HTTP 428 with required STAGING_CONFIRM_HEADER and token prompt; action is blocked.
possibleImpacts.rollback: Use staging token in request header or disable guard for controlled emergency operations.

possibleImpacts.scenario: Restore flow on custom-named database in staging
possibleImpacts.result: Identifier-safe SQL now escapes quotes so restore can proceed with consistent naming conventions.
possibleImpacts.rollback: If behavior changes, revert restore SQL constructor and run restore with prior binary.

possibleImpacts.scenario: Path contains spaces/quotes in PowerShell full-site backup
possibleImpacts.result: JSON payload script invocation avoids string interpolation breakage and still creates ZIP+dump artifact.
possibleImpacts.rollback: Redeploy previous backup block and validate a single backup/snapshot run.

possibleImpacts.scenario: FortiGate rewrites an anchor href reader to the internal target URL
possibleImpacts.result: Rewrite-resistant readers return the public proxy URL, allowing CSRF injection and cookie transport to remain consistent.
possibleImpacts.rollback: Revert STS-PROXY-001 and require direct-network access until the proxy integration is repaired.
